title: Prepare the portable agent library setup kit
summary: Created a self-contained receiving-agent entry point, short skill, workflow and role prompts, private-account configuration/Sheets templates, acceptance matrix, synthetic PDF fixture and scoped pilot history.
outcome: Offline package validation and 13 unit/fixture checks pass. An independent receiving-agent review found and then confirmed fixes for skill-reference portability, worker ownership/recovery and local test prerequisites. No recipient-account deployment or live translation benchmark is certified by these checks. Private project-memory import is not verified by publishing this record.
decisions: Use Google Drive for files and Google Sheets for catalog plus shared operational memory.
A coordinator/executor uses distinct Review and QA contexts with source-grounded version-specific evidence.
Separate setup readiness, observed automation and long-term operational acceptance.
Keep credentials, books and real account-specific destinations outside Git.
next_actions: Run the documented fresh-account bootstrap with authorized connections and record the operational acceptance results.
Keep recipient library data private; distribute only the sanitized public setup kit.
Reconcile final pilot reports and any future benchmark with their actual evidence, without changing historical initial-artifact review claims.
